1.1.0.0.added:
Origin X and Y properties, actions and expressions.
Justify, with justify tuning.
Wrapping mode None.
Overflow and Ellipsis toggles.
Max lines.
Letter, word and paragraph spacing, with [letterspacing] and [wordspacing] tags.
Rendering as columns.
Flow exclusions: text wraps around picked instances.
Inline icons with [icon] and an Icon set property.
[space] tag.
Overline, and [decorationcolor], [decorationthickness], [decorationoffset] and [decorationstyle] tags.
[shadow] tag.
1.1.0.0.changed:
Alignment properties are new floats. Instances from 1.0.0.0 go back to left and top.
Text direction defaults to Auto.
New instances are 200 by 30.
New Spacing property group and action categories.
1.1.0.0.fixed: Wrong wrapping with fonts that kern against the space.
